title: A broken formula leaves conversation hope

captions.physics: Revealing a familiar agreement’s mistaken basis
captions.energy: Finding a response to changed conditions

meaning: You can reveal a familiar agreement’s mistaken basis and respond to changed conditions, preserving hope for further conversation without guaranteeing the old routine.
text: On your Vishuddha, the Tower in the physical position reveals a familiar agreement’s mistaken basis. The Wheel of Fortune in energy encourages responding to changed conditions rather than restricting conversation to an earlier arrangement. The Star in emotions brings hope for an open continuation. You can discover that a repeated phrase no longer promises an action understood by both. Hope concerns the possibility of further conversation, rather than compulsory restoration of a convenient routine or a guaranteed happy outcome to an argument.

Suppose you said, “As usual, we will call after closing”, overlooking that closing times now differ. Each awaited an obvious signal that did not exist for the other. **Hope for conversation can withstand revising a familiar formula**. You name the mismatch and discuss what is actually possible today. The mistake may disappoint, but another response need not reproduce the former timetable. There is a sense of room for conversation to develop even without an exact time immediately available.

Openness becomes evasion if hope substitutes for an answer to a particular expectation: “We will certainly talk sometime” replaces acknowledging present uncertainty. The constructive Wheel of Fortune helps match words to actual conditions. You can leave the future room and clearly name what remains unknown. Hope requires neither promising availability at every moment nor treating the lack of an immediate solution as proof that further conversation has become impossible.
